items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: It was the first record that I bought for myself was Dave Brubeck “Jazz Goes to College.”

ctx.x: I know exactly what you’re talking about because I was in college right around that time and yeah, the scene for jazz was great in colleges and then it wasn’t.
It was the first record that I bought for myself was Dave Brubeck “Jazz Goes to College.”
So the next step after Gary Burton, did your calendar get filled up like in a hurry?
